The source R3 text confirms the u=0 formula f(r)=r/2 - chi*r^2/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))^2) giving e(r)=0 in the safe region; the present B,C generalizes this to arbitrary u by replacing 1 with a=1+u throughout, yielding the exact Newton correction g=sqrt(a^2+r)-a when chi_r*chi_u=1.",

(3) The expression is C-infinity on |r|<2, |u|>1 (i.e. a>0 and a^2+r>0), which strictly contains the outer rectangle |r|<=1/2, |u|<=1/4. (4) Analytic-domain certificate remains NOT_CERTIFIED (finite numeric checks only); this does not affect the numeric answer. (5) If a future stage shows u outside [-1/4,1/4] while |r|<1/4, chi_u will attenuate and the residual will be nonzero but bounded by O(r^2)+O(u*r^2); this is the designed attenuation, not a bug."
